objective: Make System quest selection strategy-first: live XMind supplies preferred long-horizon direction when relevant and available, while current domain/live owners retain real-world truth, hard obligations, safety, feasibility and execution evidence. No external app mirror or new state owner is introduced.

roles_before.artifact: Live XMind owns exact current strategy/map structure.
Domain/live owners own current real-world facts, constraints and execution truth.
System Controller selects the highest-value feasible quest from causally relevant domains.
Routing does not prove live connector availability in a particular run.
Neon system_events owns derived RPG state, not external app data.
Existing Quest v2 lifecycle/evidence rules govern active quest continuation and rewards.
Base SHA preserves complete pre-change behavior.

role_dispositions.destination: XMind remains strategy/map owner and becomes the primary strategic alignment signal for discretionary long-horizon choice.
Current owners still override projected/stale XMind claims for facts, safety, hard obligations and execution evidence.
After mandatory/safety/hard-external and active-commitment gates, verified XMind alignment is the primary discretionary value signal; feasibility and timing shape execution.
Selected sources receive an ephemeral LIVE/FALLBACK/UNKNOWN preflight; connection status is not persisted as truth.
Neon keeps derived RPG events and minimal action provenance only; no generic external-data cache is added.
Strategic selection cannot bypass existing lifecycle, evidence or current one-active-quest operating constraint.
Existing XMind strategy provenance remains read-only and optional; no sync or map copy is added.
Reverting the controller/spec/guard delta restores base semantics without data migration.

capability_probes.assertion: System still selects a justified quest when XMind is unavailable or immaterial, without inventing XMind state.
A merely scheduled item does not outrank materially stronger verified strategic alignment unless it carries a real mandatory, hard-external, safety or blocking constraint.
Stale, unavailable or conflicting XMind cannot override current truth, safety, hard external deadlines or execution evidence.
Quest scoring/completion/timing/rewards and unrelated domain routing remain unchanged.
Recorded base SHA remains the complete rollback point.

tests.expected: Strategy-first selection and graceful-degradation markers pass.
XMind current authority and historical snapshot separation remain intact.
